Small Q&A!

### What does this add / do? - This adds the quiver (from indev 0.31) to 1.21.1, it also expands this feature by adding 16 dye variants and allows arrow usage when in your inventory! ### Will this mod be ported to forge or neoforge? - Nope. I just don't have the time to maintain multiple mod versions. ### How do i get access to betas? - You can access betas via my [Patreon page](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Addie_Astarr)! ### Can you add... / How do you use...? - You can suggest stuff on the github issues page or on the my official [discord server](https://discord.gg/5JDKuzarcS)! I will also answer any questions on either site! ------------- -------------

Recommended Mods!
